title: AshA2ui Function Catalog
description: The functions an AshA2ui agent and renderer share beside the basic catalog: ashAction, which a renderer calls on the agent for every server-handled interaction, and downloadFile, which the agent calls on the renderer to deliver an export. It declares no components. The shipped LiveView hook (priv/js/ash_a2ui_hook.js) registers the implementations.

ashAction.description: Runs a named ash_a2ui action on the agent. The renderer sends it as callAgentFunction; the agent answers with agentFunctionResponse after its data-model updates.

sourceComponentId.description: The id of the component the interaction came from.

context.description: The action's inputs. Bindings resolve against the data model before the call is sent.

downloadFile.description: Downloads a file the agent generated: exactly one of dataUrl (an inline data: URL, how AshA2ui delivers CSV exports) or url (a signed download URL, for hosts that upload instead of inlining), saved under filename. The agent sends it as callRendererFunction after an export. This function has no return value.

filename.description: The name the downloaded file is saved under.

mimeType.description: The file's MIME type (informational; the URL's own type wins where applicable).

dataUrl.description: The file content as a data: URL.

url.description: A (signed) URL the file is downloaded from.
